column1: # FUT REBORN - FIFA 16 Legends (66 cards). Ratings / positions / 6 stats = official FIFA 16 Legends table (fifauteam.com). GK stats = diving handling kicking reflexes speed positioning.
# id = the real FIFA 16 player id (the id gives the real face + card art). Ids come from community FIFA 16 face / id lists and were NOT tested in your game.
# id EMPTY = no id found yet: that legend is skipped by the server (listed in save\icons_unmatched.txt). Fill the id and he is added.
# nation = FIFA nation id (flag), taken from PlayersData.cs.
